single_core_variable: An independently linked decisive support outcome may own the current acknowledgement act only when the whole current utterance contains support/softener/thanks and no new or unresolved content.
baseline: Inherited M28 exact-normalized-token support closure with the same supplied upstream outcome, plan and pending state
system: Compositional full-coverage support-act gate, existing M28 plan/surface authority and precise validation closure; upstream M27/M37 evidence is unchanged
scope: Controlled typed-feedback mechanism, not evaluation of upstream support truth or a same-model generation comparison
implementation_acceptance: Whole-utterance coverage prevents yes plus new request or quoted support from being swallowed
Do not create a fresh generic validation request on a pure confirmed turn
Close an existing pending only with matching response prediction evidence; unlinked legacy pending remains unknown
M39 verifies the current acknowledgement act, not a previous branch re-executed on feedback
Actual graph and same-cycle history preserve current closure and surface evidence
Isolated Safari seed/support/reuse plus mixed request and self identity; no production memory
Retain all prior frozen files, initial failures and new Web limitations
formal_rule: Freeze this reserve and protocol before code; freeze implementation/evaluator/tests before one formal run; never tune or rerun to erase failures.
evidence_boundary: Researcher-authored bounded mechanism contracts and separate actual Web observations. Not independent holdout, blind human preference, universal multilingual support semantics, human equivalence or a biological brain equation. No acoustic inference from text.
